title: Measurable Matroids: Foundations and Min--Max Theorems
summary: We develop a measure-theoretic analogue of matroid theory on standard atomless measure spaces. Motivated by the quotient-convergence framework for submodular set functions, our aim is to identify suitable measurable objects on the limit side of finite matroid theory and to develop their basic structural and optimization theory. We prove that measurable matroids admit equivalent descriptions by independent sets, bases, rank functions, and closure operators. The class includes normalized finite matroids, cycle matroids of graphings, and measurable analogues of partition, nested, lattice path,…
